title: Casual Music Discs
description: Gives non-craftable music discs crafting recipes for peaceful and casual players, and players that just want to listen to some tunes.
body:
Gives non-craftable music discs crafting recipes for peaceful and casual players, and players that just want to listen to some tunes. Uses concrete and terracotta for ingredients that are vaguely color matched to the discs, and flint (to "scratch" the music into the record)

Created using [Crafting Recipe Generator](https://crafting.thedestruc7i0n.ca/)
